ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The picture shows one circle, one square, and three equal circles arranged in a horizontal row. The same two dashed horizontal lines bound the top and bottom of the single circle, the square, and the three-circle row, so the square side is equal to one circle diameter. The three circles are tangent side by side, and the thread around them forms a capsule shape: two straight horizontal parts plus two rounded end parts. Reasoning: The thread around one circle is a cm, so one full circular circumference is a. In the capsule around the three circles, the two rounded end parts together make exactly one full circle circumference, so they contribute a cm. The square perimeter is b cm, and since the square side equals one circle diameter, b equals four diameters. The two straight horizontal parts of the capsule together also equal four diameters, so they contribute b cm. Therefore the required thread length is a + b.

method.method_draft: Read the picture as three congruent disks with centers on one horizontal line, tangent consecutively, all having the same diameter as the height of the square. Let the common radius be r. From the text and diagram, surrounding one circle gives a=2πr, and surrounding the square gives b=4·(2r)=8r. The tight thread around the three fixed circles is the boundary of the convex hull of the three disks, equivalently a stadium formed by thickening the segment joining the first and third centers by radius r. The distance between the first and third centers is 4r, so the stadium perimeter is 2·4r+2πr=8r+2πr=b+a.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中左侧有一个圆，圆的上下端正好夹在两条水平虚线之间；中间有一个正方形，它的上边和下边也分别落在这两条虚线上，所以正方形边长等于圆的直径。右侧有三个相同的圆横向排列，彼此相切，且同样夹在两条水平虚线之间，外面画了一圈线表示要用线围住这三个不移动的圆。

推理：设每个圆的半径为 r。围住一个圆所需线长是圆周长，所以 a=2πr。正方形的边长等于圆的直径 2r，因此围住正方形所需线长 b=4·2r=8r。三个相切圆的外侧紧绷线形成一个“体育场形”边界：上下各有一段长度为两个圆心之间的总距离 4r 的直线段，左右两端合起来正好是一整个圆周 2πr。因此所需线长为 2·4r+2πr=8r+2πr=b+a。
